svg.title: ADR026: onboarding as built on 2026-11-09
svg.text: Wireframe of today's paths to a first ledger after the 2026-11-07 revert. Screens are schematic; labels are the shipped English copy.
Create your first ledger to start…
only if the user finds the button
has a ledger → the default ledger
Native: back to the tab bar
Agents and the terminal (shipped, not a screen)
REST / GraphQL / MCP createLedger take an optional setup:
historyStart, capabilities, accounts; plus requestId for retries.
previewLedgerSetup shows the files and accounts without creating.
bea cloud ledger create studio --preset freelance@1 --currency EUR
Neither web nor native screen sends setup today:
every hosted ledger made in an app is the USD Starter or Sample.
Create a new Beancount ledger to start managing your finances.
Empty books with a standard chart
Only you and collaborators can access
Button reads "Save", not "Create ledger" (w3/648's fix was lost in the revert)
Empty books with a standard chart
1. Sign-up with next lands on an empty /ledger
Path B never shows welcome. Decided, not built.
Native says "Create"; web lost the w3/648 rename.
3. Sample sits beside Starter as a peer choice
Web and native: nothing says it is fictional,
and ledger lists do not mark demo ledgers.
4. No situation, currency, title, or first account
Every app-made ledger is the USD Starter, though
the API and CLI already accept a full setup.
5. Consent sign-up offers no choice at all
6. The next step ends at a two-item checklist
No "Record a transaction / Import / Verify a
balance" choice; language is English until switched.
Sources: register-otp.tsx, login-page, welcome-page, ledger-form.tsx, create-ledger-screen.tsx
